title: Consolidation: Synthesis: What It Means to Speak and Understand Hungarian Today

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can synthesize the overarching themes of Hungarian cultural, literary, and historical identity at B2 mastery.
I can fluently integrate complex discourse connectors, participial clauses, and register shifts across varied topics.
I can articulate my personal relationship with the Hungarian language and express readiness for C1 fluency.
